description: Coral Reef Watch is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Coral Reef Conservation Program; NOAA / NESDIS / Center for Satellite Applications and Research and Office of Satellite and Product Operations; NOAA National Weather Service, Climate Prediction Center. This site offers near-real-time products based on satellite, in situ, and modeled data to help managers prepare for and respond to environmental stress to coral reef ecosystems, especially heat stress. Available tools and products help people:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
